abilities.name: Ground Evasion
abilities.description: On the ground, push R + X to dodge opponent's attack.

abilities.name: Midair Evasion
abilities.description: In the air, push R + X to dodge opponent's attack.

abilities.name: Ground Block
abilities.description: On the ground, push R to guard against foe's attack.

abilities.name: Midair Block
abilities.description: In the air, push R to guard against foe's attack.

abilities.name: Aerial Recovery
abilities.description: When tumbling through the air, press X to break fall.

abilities.name: Recovery Attack
abilities.description: Press circle or square to attack while flying through air. Must enable Aerial Recovery.

abilities.name: Controlled Recovery
abilities.description: Can move while breaking fall. Aerial Recovery must be enabled.

abilities.name: Wall Jump
abilities.description: Press X after a Quickmove to run on a wall for a high jump.

abilities.name: Air Dash
abilities.description: While Quickmoving, press triangle to dash toward opponent. Hold button to extend range.

abilities.name: Reverse Air Dash
abilities.description: While Quickmoving, press triangle to dash away from opponent. Hold button to extend range.
abilities.notes: Like Air Dash, faster than other dashes.

abilities.name: Free Air Dash
abilities.description: Press R + triangle to dash toward opponent. Hold button to extend range.
abilities.notes: Staple. Works with Assist Gauge Up Dash.

abilities.name: Reverse Free Air Dash
abilities.description: Press R + triangle to dash away from opponent. Hold button to extend range.
abilities.notes: Recommended for Kefka. Works with Assist Gauge Up Dash.

abilities.name: Omni Air Dash
abilities.description: Press R + triangle to dash in any direction. Hold button to extend range.

abilities.name: Omni Air Dash+
abilities.description: Press R + triangle to dash in any direction. Turns capable during dash.

abilities.name: Ground Dash
abilities.description: While on ground, press R + triangle to dash toward opponent. Hold button to extend range.
abilities.notes: Works with Assist Gauge Up Dash.

abilities.name: Reverse Ground Dash
abilities.description: While on ground, press R + triangle to dash away from opponent. Hold button too extend range. Works with Assist Gauge Up Dash.

abilities.name: Omni Ground Dash
abilities.description: While on ground, press R + triangle to dash in any direction. Hold button to extend range.

abilities.name: Omni Ground Dash+
abilities.description: Press R + triangle to dash in any direction. Turns capable during dash.

abilities.name: Multi Air Slide
abilities.description: Press X after jumping to dash in any direction. Hold button to extend range.
abilities.notes: Available when no jumps remain / after an air dodge.

abilities.name: Multi Air Slide+
abilities.description: Multi Air Slide can be performed twice.

abilities.name: Air Dash Boost
abilities.description: Air Dash speed increases.
abilities.notes: 4 % speed increase. Only affects the abilities "Air Dash" and "Reverse Air Dash". Details here

abilities.name: Free Air Dash Boost
abilities.description: Free Air Dash and Omni Air Dash speed increase.

abilities.name: Assist Gauge Up dash
abilities.description: Assist Gauge fills when using Air Dash, Free Air Dash, or Ground Dash.

abilities.name: Glide Boost
abilities.description: Glide boost. Glide must be enabled.
abilities.notes: Terra, Kefka, Sephiroth and Kuja only.

abilities.name: EX Glide Boost
abilities.description: Glide boost while in EX Mode.

abilities.name: Speed Boost
abilities.description: Slight movement speed boost.

abilities.name: Speed Boost+
abilities.description: Movement speed boost.

abilities.name: Speed Boost++
abilities.description: Large movement speed boost.

abilities.name: Jump Boost
abilities.description: Slight jump strength boost.

abilities.name: Jump Boost+
abilities.description: Jump strength boost.

abilities.name: Jump Boost++
abilities.description: Large jump strength boost.

abilities.name: Jump Times Boost
abilities.description: Jump times increase by 1.

abilities.name: Jump Times Boost
abilities.description: Jump times increase by 2.

abilities.name: Jump Times Boost++
abilities.description: Jump times increase by 3.

abilities.name: Ground Evasion Boost
abilities.description: Increase movement distance for ground evasion. Must enable Ground Evasion.
abilities.notes: Staple. +2m distance boost. Can make grounded dodge cancel combos more difficult.

abilities.name: Midair Evasion Boost
abilities.description: Increase movement distance for midair evasion. Must enable Midair Evasion.
abilities.notes: Staple. +2m distance boost. Stacks with Adamant Chains' set bonus.

abilities.name: Evasion Boost
abilities.description: Increase duration of invincibility after evasion.

abilities.name: Descent Speed Boost
abilities.description: Press X after jumping to quickly descend.
abilities.notes: Available after jumps and Multi Air Slide.

abilities.name: Zero Gravity
abilities.description: Press X after jumping to temporarily stop in midair. Release X to descend normally.
abilities.notes: Available after jumps and Multi Air Slide.

abilities.name: Always Target Indicator
abilities.description: Target indicatoro showing opponent's position will always be displayed.

abilities.name: EX Core Lock On
abilities.description: When EX Core is present, push L while locked on to lock onto the EX Core.

abilities.name: Assist Lock On
abilities.description: When foe's Assist is present, push L to lock onto their Assist.

abilities.name: RPG Mode Boost
abilities.description: Takes immediate action when command is issued in RPG Mode battle.

abilities.name: Auto Assist Lock On
abilities.description: Automatically lock onto opponent's Assist Character.
abilities.notes: Attacks will immediately steer towards the assist character as soon as the assist call happens.

abilities.name: Auto Assist
abilities.description: Automatically summons Assist Character.

abilities.name: Auto Chase
abilities.description: Automatically chase foes.

abilities.name: Auto Recovery
abilities.description: Automatically break fall.
abilities.notes: Useful for verifying combos where aerial recovery is possible.

abilities.name: Auto EX Burst
abilities.description: Automatically use EX Burst.

abilities.name: Auto EX Command
abilities.description: Automatically input EX Burst commands.

abilities.name: Auto EX Command Ω
abilities.description: Automatically input EX Burst commands perfectly.

abilities.name: Auto EX Defense
abilities.description: Automatically defend against EX Bursts.

abilities.name: Auto EX Defense Ω
abilities.description: Automatically defend against EX Bursts perfectly.

abilities.name: Reverse Paradigm
abilities.description: Order of Ravager and Commando are reversed when using Paradigm Shift.

abilities.name: Disable Bravery Reduction
abilities.description: Bravery does not deplete.

abilities.name: Disable EX Gauge Lock
abilities.description: EX Gauge fills steadily.
abilities.notes: Feral Chaos only. EX absorption fills the EX meter.

abilities.name: Disable Assist Lock
abilities.description: Assist Gauge fills steadily.
abilities.notes: Feral Chaos only. Attacks fill the Assist meter.

abilities.name: Precision Jump
abilities.description: Press X at high point of jump to jump higher than usual.
abilities.notes: Peak of the jump. Recommended for Kain and Kefka. This can also be done after an attack finishes if it was done at the peak of a jump.

abilities.name: Precision Block
abilities.description: Blocks are more effective when well-timed.
abilities.notes: Staggers against Mid & High priority instead of guard crushed if  blocked at the first 4 frames.

abilities.name: Precision Evasion
abilities.description: Evasions are more effective when well-timed.
abilities.notes: Extends invincibility to the end of a dodge if evasion is registered within first 4 frames.

abilities.name: Concentration
abilities.description: Bravery increases after not attacking for a length of time.
abilities.notes: Activates after doing nothing for 5 seconds. 10 % of raw BRV every 1.67 seconds (100F)

abilities.name: Concentration +
abilities.description: Bravery increases after not attacking for a length of time. Stronger than Concentration.
abilities.notes: Activates after doing nothing for 5 seconds. 30 % of raw BRV every 1.67 seconds (100F).

abilities.name: Concentration ++
abilities.description: Bravery increases after not attacking for a length of time. Stronger than Concentration +.
abilities.notes: Activates after doing nothing for 5 seconds. 50 % of raw BRV every 1.67 seconds (100F)

abilities.name: Snooze and Lose
abilities.description: When foe doesn't attack for a certain length of time, foe's bravery begins to fall.
abilities.notes: Activates after opponent does not attack for 5 seconds. Opponent loses 30% of raw BRV every 1.67 seconds (100F). Obsolete due to assist meter.

abilities.name: Achy
abilities.description: Gain "near death" status with more HP.
abilities.notes: Activates under 26 % of max HP instead of 21 %.

abilities.name: Achy +
abilities.description: Gain "near death" status with even more HP.
abilities.notes: Activates under 31 % of max HP instead of 21 %.

abilities.name: Magic Shield
abilities.description: When near death, magic damage cut by 20 %.

abilities.name: Physical Shield
abilities.description: When near death, physical damage cut by 20 %.

abilities.name: Bravery Regen
abilities.description: In EX Mode, gain bravery instead of regenerating HP.

abilities.name: Perseverance
abilities.description: Decreases Wall Rush damage at times.
abilities.notes: 20% chance of -95% BRV Wall Rush damage taken.

abilities.name: Reflect Boost
abilities.description: Increases magic damage when deflecting opponent's magic attack.

abilities.name: Counterattack
abilities.description: Critical hit rate rises when opponent is attacking.

abilities.name: Sneak Attack
abilities.description: Critical hit rate rises when attacking from behind.

abilities.name: First Strike
abilities.description: When landing the first BRV attack, critical hit rate of the first combo rises.

abilities.name: EX Critical Boost
abilities.description: Further boosts critical hit rate during EX Mode.

abilities.name: Cat Nip
abilities.description: Boosts critical hit rate when opponent has chance of a one-hit victory.

abilities.name: Riposte
abilities.description: Boosts critical hit rate when attacking staggering opponent. Also activates with guard breaks, e.g. when higher priority attack connects.

abilities.name: Back to the Wall
abilities.description: Boosts critical hit rate when near death.

abilities.name: Gambler's Spirit
abilities.description: Boosts critical hit rate after being afflicted by Break.

abilities.name: Anti-EX
abilities.description: Boosts critical hit rate when opponent is in EX Mode.

abilities.name: Spite
abilities.description: Critical hit rate increases when opponent's bravery exceeds 3000.

abilities.name: Fragile Pride
abilities.description: Critical hit rate increases when opponent's attacks have all been blocked or evaded.

abilities.name: Assist Critical Boost
abilities.description: Critical hit rate of Assist character's attacks increases.

abilities.description: Counterattack ability effect disabled.

abilities.description: Assist Critical Boost ability effect disabled.
